title: Home-Site Lease Renewal and Rent-Increase Schedule by Lot Class
content:
**Renewal timing, renewal increase rates, holdover and month-to-month increases on the Home-Site Lease**

- **Renewal offer lead days**: calendar days before the current term end date on which the renewal offer falls due.
- **Renewal response days**: calendar days after the renewal offer date by which the resident must sign the renewal (the offer's response deadline).
- **Twelve-month renewal increase rate**: the rent increase applied to the twelve-month-equivalent rent when a twelve-month renewal term begins.
- **Twenty-four-month renewal increase rate**: the rent increase applied to the twelve-month-equivalent rent when a twenty-four-month renewal term begins, the rent then being fixed for the full term.
- **Holdover basis**: what a fixed term becomes when it ends with no renewal signed — conversion to month to month at the month-to-month premium, or automatic renewal for twelve months at the twelve-month renewal increase.
- **Month-to-month increase cap**: the largest increase one rent-increase notice may apply to a month-to-month lease, as a percentage of the current monthly site rent.
- **Rent increases per 12 months**: the most rent increases that may take effect on one lease in any trailing 12-month window.

| Lot class | Offer lead days | Response days | Twelve-month renewal increase | Twenty-four-month renewal increase | Holdover basis | Month-to-month increase cap | Increases per 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 75 | 45 | 4.6 percent | not applicable | converts to month to month | 6.0 percent | 1 |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 75 | 45 | 4.6 percent | not applicable | converts to month to month | 6.0 percent | 1 |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 75 | 45 | 4.9 percent | 4.1 percent | converts to month to month | 6.5 percent | 1 |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 75 | 45 | 4.9 percent | 4.1 percent | converts to month to month | 6.5 percent | 1 |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 75 | 45 | 5.3 percent | 4.5 percent | automatic twelve-month renewal | not applicable | 1 |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 75 | 45 | 5.8 percent | 4.9 percent | automatic twelve-month renewal | not applicable | 1 |

"Not applicable" marks a rate for a term the lot class does not offer: the single-section lot classes offer no twenty-four-month term, and the Greenbelt and Lakefront lot classes offer no month-to-month term.

*Hypothetical reading.* For a fixed term ending on the last day of a month, a renewal offer falls due 75 days before that end date, and an offer delivered on a given day carries a response deadline 45 calendar days after that day.
